October 21, 2026 
 
To, 
The Listing Department 
The National Stock Exchange of 
India Limited (“NSE”) 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G Bandra-
Kurla Complex, Bandra (East) Mumbai 
– 400 051  
 
Symbol: RUNWALENTR 
The Department of Corporate Services 
BSE Limited (“BSE”) 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy 
Towers, Dalal Street 
Mumbai – 400001 
 
 
Scrip Code: 544959 
 
 
 
Subject: Intimation of Q1FY27 Earnings conference call pursuant to Regulation 
30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘Listing Regulations’) 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Listing Regulations, 
we wish to inform you that a conference call will be held on Monday October 26, 
2026, at 15:30 hrs (IST) in respect of 1st Quarter’s Financial Results i.e. Unaudited 
Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. 
Dial in and other details of the call are as follows: 
Date 
October 26, 2026, Monday 
Time 
15:30 Hrs IST  
Universal Dial In: 
+91 22 6280 1341 & +91 22 7115 8242 
International 
Dial-In 
Numbers 
US 18667462133,  
UK 08081011573 
Singapore 8001012045 
Hong Kong 800964448 
 
 
Users may also join the Call by Click Here 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
This 
intimation 
will 
also 
be 
hosted 
on 
the 
Company's 
website 
viz 
www.runwalenterprises.com.  
 
Note:  
1. The date of the aforesaid conference is subject to change due to exigencies on the 
part of Investors/Company. In case of revision of schedule, the same shall be 
communicated to you. 
2. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information will be shared at the above-mentioned 
meeting(s). 
 
We request you to kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking You, 
For and on behalf Runwal Enterprises Limited 
 
 
Abhishek Kumar Jain 
Company Secretary & Compliance officer 
 
ABHISHEK 
KUMAR 
JAIN
